pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5622
Date 15 / 1 / 34

January 13 34.

Consul General for Switzerland,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter dated January 9, 1934, enclosing
a document to be served upon a Mr. Gottlieb Reimann,
and to state that service has been duly effected.
The duplicate document duly signed by the officer
serving together with a copy of his report is
returned herewith.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your most obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Garrard
Commissioner of Police.

HR

Oanded 15 Jany
7-56-6

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 5622
日期 1934年1月15日

1934年1月13日。

致瑞士驻上海总领事，

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1934年1月9日来函，随函附有一份需送达给 Gottlieb Reimann 先生的文件，并告知送达手续已 duly 完成。现随函退回由执行送达任务的警员 duly 签署的文件副本及其报告复印件一份。

谨此致意，
先生，
您最顺从的仆人，

（签名）F. W. Garrard
警务处处长。

HR

1月15日交办
7-56-6

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. C. File No. REGISTRY. No. D. 5622 Date 12 / 1 / 34）
Date January 12, 1934

Subject (in full) Letter from Swiss Consulate General enclosing a document
to be served on Mr. Gottlieb Rebmann.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by D.J. Sweeney

With reference to the attached letter dated January
9, 1934 from the Swiss Consulate General enclosing a summons
in duplicate to be served on Mr. Gottlieb Rebmann, c/o Ever-
bright Metal Co., 609 Ward Road. I have to report having
served the summons on the above named person at 3 p.m. on
January 12, 1934. G. Rebmann is residing at No. 284 Route
Tenant de la Tour and is employed with a Mr. De Cosier who
has an office in Room 429, No. 9 Foochow Road (Agency for
Everbright Metal Co.). At that office Mr. Rebmann is known
under the name of G.R. Huber.

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处。C. 档案号 登记处。编号 D. 5622 日期 1934年1月12日）
日期 1934年1月12日

主题（全称） 瑞士总领事馆来函，附有一份需送达给 Gottlieb Rebmann 先生的文件。

呈报人 D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人 D.J. Sweeney

兹就随附的1934年1月9日瑞士总领事馆来函一事进行报告，该函附有两份需送达给 Ward Road（华德路）609号 Everbright Metal Co.（永明金属公司）转交 Gottlieb Rebmann 先生的传票副本。本人须报告，已于1934年1月12日下午3时向上述人士送达传票。G. Rebmann 现居住于 Route Tenant de la Tour（唐耐路）284号，受雇于一位 De Cosier 先生，后者在福州路9号429室设有办公室（永明金属公司代理处）。在该办公室，Rebmann 先生以 G.R. Huber 之名为人所知。

G. Tcheremshansky
侦探警佐。

特别股主管警员。

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL DE SUISSE
EN CHINE

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. I. S. M. REGISTRE / D 5622 / 11 / 1 / 24）

Shanghai, January 8th, 1934.

Sir,

I shall feel much obliged if you
will kindly cause the enclosed document to be
served upon Mr. Gottlieb Rebmann at 609 Ward
Road or 156 Seymour Road, and have the duplicate
returned to me, bearing the signature of the
officer who will have been on service.

./.
* To previous record
dated

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）
CONSUL GENERAL OF SWITZERLAND.
